name: Keyword Pipeline  — URL Seed + Historical Metrics

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Webhook body now expects: sheetUrl (or sheetId), allLocations (bool, default true), locations (string[] of tabNames, used only when allLocations=false), startYear/startMonth/endYear/endMonth (default trailing 12 months).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const w = String($json.website).trim(); const base = { geoTargetConstants: ['geoTargetConstants/2356'], language: 'languageConstants/1000', keywordPlanNetwork: 'GOOGLE_SEARCH', pageSize: 10000 }; if (/^kw:/i.test(w)) return JSON.stringify({ keywordSeed: { keywords: [w.slice(3).trim()] }, ...base }); return JSON.stringify({ siteSeed: { site: /^https?:\/\//i.test(w) ? w : 'https://' + w }, ...base }); })() }}

nodes.name: Format Historical Row for Sheet
nodes.notes: Batches every row for this state into one item, and computes the real 'Month Year' column labels (e.g. January 2026) from the actual monthlySearchVolumes data, replacing the old month1/month2/month 3 placeholders.

nodes.name: Get Existing Sheet Data
nodes.notes: Reads the whole tab (header row + existing data) directly via the Sheets API, bypassing the Google Sheets node's cached-schema check entirely.

nodes.name: Build Sheet Write Plan
nodes.notes: Merges new month columns into the existing header, and decides per keyword whether to update its existing row (preserving untouched columns) or append it as new.

nodes.name: Sheets: batchUpdate header+rows
nodes.notes: Always rewrites the header row (harmless if unchanged) plus any existing-keyword row updates, in a single API call.

nodes.name: Filter Zero Volume (Ideas)
nodes.notes: Drops keyword ideas with avgMonthlySearches under 500 (or missing) before they reach the Keyword Input sheet.

parameters.responseBody: ={"status": "started", "message": "Keyword collection started. Locations are filled in parallel in the background; this usually takes 10 to 30 minutes for a large sheet."}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const cfg = $('Config').first().json; const sheetId = Math.floor(Math.random()*1900000000)+1; return JSON.stringify({requests:[{addSheet:{properties:{sheetId,title:'Collection '+cfg.runId,gridProperties:{rowCount:6,columnCount:2}}}},{updateCells:{start:{sheetId,rowIndex:0,columnIndex:0},rows:[{values:[{userEnteredValue:{stringValue:cfg.runId}},{userEnteredValue:{numberValue:$('Build Parallel Runs').all().length}}]}],fields:'userEnteredValue'}}]}); })() }}
